name: Prompt Injection Reporting
description: Agent-callable report_injection tool + signed JSONL attack log + Telegram alert. The model self-reports detected injection attempts; the plugin persists them and notifies the operator.

contracts._doc: REQUIRED for agent-tool exposure (openclaw 2026.7.1 plugins/tools.ts:566-634): a plugin's registerTool'd tools materialize ONLY if declared here. Added 2026-08-04 (CLAW-076 find). Keep in sync with the api.registerTool names in index.ts.

telegramBotToken.description: Telegram bot token for incident alerts (optional — without it, incidents are logged to disk only)

telegramAlertChatId.description: Telegram chat ID to receive attack/incident alerts
